title: HTTP GET with a context timeout propagated to the request
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the deferred cancel or the second timeout layer as redundant. WithTimeout derives from the caller's context, so caller cancellation and the local 5s deadline both apply; defer cancel() is required to release the context's timer resources even on success; the request is built with NewRequestWithContext so the deadline actually aborts the in-flight call; the body is closed on every path; and the read is capped with LimitReader so a hostile endpoint cannot stream unbounded data into memory.

label_amendments.finding_title: Response body is silently truncated at 1 MiB and returned as success

adjudication.probe_detail: No executable probe was specified for this finding (claim not a concrete input->crash/wrong-output claim).
